reviews.x: I appreciate the little tin the product comes in. It helps keep things clean and organized. So far, for over 1 month, the tongue cleaner has been rust free and looks clean and new after each use. I cannot claim to notice fresher breath but after each use my tongue does look cleaner. I like the product and recommend it to anyone that wants a tongue cleaner. The reason I give it 4 stars is due to the claim to eliminate bad breath. I think it cleans the tongue and removes some of the odor causing b

I heard a lot about tongue scrapers. Intrigued,  but not sold. I decided to order this set, mainly because of the good price and it had a lot of good reviews. I agree when reviewers say it's important to find a well made and not stamped quality scraper. You dont want anything pokey on your tongue.  This brand was great. Smooth edges, firm, and feels good in your hand.  There are other models (two-hand variety), but I like the simple one hand tool.  Will buy these again for gifts and replacement

reviews.t: Amazed at the difference it makes!!
reviews.x: Bought it because I thought it's probably a good Idea. It was a GREAT idea--after using it one time I noticed a huge difference. It felt like I had more room in my mouth. It was like a spring cleaning. My one wish was that it included directions--which one to use first, or how many times to scrape. It's not difficult to use though. It's also very easy to clean and the company includes a few cleaning napkins. HIGHLY recommend it!!

I had no idea I needed one of these and now I won’t travel without it. The case is handy and came with a few alcohol wipes, plus keeps them sanitized between uses (I recommend dropping them into a cup of alcohol after every use). They do what they promise. It’s gross, but that’s why they’re needed. Absolute necessity to my every day oral care now.

reviews.t: Nice look, and stronger than the plastic one
reviews.x: I had a plastic scraper before, and it's broken when I used it the third or fourth time. So, it's nice to have a metal one. When I ordered this, I didn't really expect something special, as it's quite cheap, but it works great. I am glad I chose this instead of the more expensive one. It did the job for what I need, and for me, that's enough.
Tongue scraper is a super disgusting yet super satisfying product.I never wanted to scrape everything out of my tongue, but I did scrape all the bacteria and stuff out of my tongue.Love it.
I used to love my plastic tongue scraper, I am glad this is metal sturdy and won't break. The amount of crap that comes off the tongues is always so gross but relieving

My  husband has been  hospitalized for several months and has the bad habit of sleeping with his mouth open.  He ends up with a coated tongue every morning.  Along with a toothbrush, the scrapers are helpful in cleaning his tongue on a daily basis.  The scrapers are easy to use and gentle.  The case makes storage simple.  I only wish that the handles on the scrapers were slightly longer and thicker.

I’m not to sure about the hygiene of using this product. Although I sanitized it I somehow found myself with a throat infection. I stopped using it and it went away then I soaked it in sterilized water and reused only for the infection to come back...
Love the set. Cleans the tongue really good. Nice that its metal. Easier to clean then plastic.  Comes with its own case.
Works really good! Cleans my tongue and makes my breathe smell good!

I’m a little OCD when it comes to scraping my tongue. I’ve gone through many plastic tongue scrapers, And they’ve all left me unsatisfied. These metal ones are hands-down the best I’ve ever used!  They are not sharp in a way that could ever injure your tongue. But they scrape it clean, and they can be sterilized.

Gina... I loved the product and ordered few more for my family. Pefei company has done a great job. The item was delivered within a day and was neatly packed. I loved the size of the scraper and the quality of stainless steel is very good. The box is also compact and of great quality.

reviews.t: Not as good as many others I have used.
reviews.x: I’ve been using tongue scrapers since 2003. Unfortunately this one does NOT work as well as others purchased. The container and the metal keeps it looking nice and appears free of germs. However the actual use of the product doesn’t get the gunk off your tongue the way the ones with prongs do. 2 stars for the design (no prongs, doesnt remove all gunk), 5 stars for the container and materials made out of. But functionality is only a 2-3 star. Very sad.
I bought this bc it’s easier to carry in a purse than the longer u-shaped scraper. But it is not effective in removing tongue buildup. I’ll just stick to the regular one that I have been using.
I've used plenty of tongue scrapers before but this one beats them all. The middle portion has a curve where you can place your thumb and get a better stroke.

The tongue scraper needs to be more rugged to get the whitish area off your tongue it needs to be more abrasive. Too smooth doesn't get the job done. I like the concept of the kit the holder but if it does get the stuff off your tongue then it is for show. I have to use my tongue brush with bristle after using this defeat the hold process. A major improvement is needed.

I ordered this product because the plastic ones I usually buy were not working so well. I feel that this product is worth the investment in my oral health and will last for years to come. Thanks for prompt delivery too.
I think it give you the bang for your buck. I like the grip and holder. I also love that you get 2 which you can keep in your house and the other when going out.
This is not surgical grade steel. Within 1 week of use it already started rusting/changing color.
disappointed only came with scraper

I asked for the manager but she wouldn’t get that information I asked for the managers email so I can send an email and she wouldn’t give that information also.  The Customer Service of Amazon suppresses your comments. The supervisor by the name does not care to provide service.  If Amaz

Essential item for personal dental hygiene , works amazing and as described. Nice and sturdy not cheaply made.  I first brushed with my oral B electric toothbrush,  then used the hollow scraper followed by the solid tongue scraper and all debris/buildup was removed.. nice healthy pink tongue and the freshest breath.

reviews.t: One is great, the other garbage
reviews.x: One is great the other is garbage. I bought two sets. In both sets the scraper that looks like a loop had very sharp dangerous edges. I had to throw away both from each set. But the scrapers that look like a spoon were smooth and amazing. Very easy to clean and the travel case is great.

The tongue scraper is good. Metal. Don't hit your teeth with it, of course. But, the 'Disinfecting Case' is a couple of alcohol wipes inside. They probably should have left those words off.. It makes it seem... ghetto. But as a tongue scraper, it is good.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the metal construction as sturdy, durable, and superior to plastic scrapers that break.
Many customers say the scraper effectively cleans the tongue and removes buildup.
The included case/tin is commonly appreciated for keeping the product clean and organized.
A few reviewers found the scraper ineffective at removing tongue buildup compared to other designs.
One reviewer raised hygiene concerns, reporting a recurring throat infection after use.
